WITH groups AS (
  SELECT ID, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM Examination
  GROUP BY ID
),
stats AS (
  SELECT SUM(cnt) as total_cnt, COUNT(*) as num_groups, 1.0 / COUNT(*) as avg_share
  FROM groups
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT g.ID, g.cnt, CAST(g.cnt AS REAL) / s.total_cnt as share, s.avg_share
  FROM groups g, stats s
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT cnt, share, avg_share
  FROM with_shares
  WHERE share > avg_share
)
SELECT 
  AVG(cnt) as avg_record_count,
  AVG(share) as avg_share,
  AVG(share - avg_share) as avg_excess
FROM filtered
